verdict.rationale: PagerDuty's own Status Pages give a real-time view of incident resolution status and let users "proactively and securely communicate real-time operational updates" from a single platform. That covers broadcasting structured updates outside the responder channel. However, the evidence never shows stakeholders subscribing to those updates or a dedicated internal-stakeholder audience. Webhooks and Incident Workflows are developer building blocks and earn no credit here. Missing for 10: documented stakeholder subscription mechanism, explicit internal/private status pages or stakeholder roles, independent corroboration.
